description: stockpyl provides Python inventory-optimisation and simulation implementations for single-node and multi-echelon supply chains. The provider is Project maintainers (see primary page). Geographical and temporal coverage: The library implements established inventory models; geography and period depend on user inputs. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is inventory modelling, not a road-network traffic simulator; the infrastructure use requires a defined supply-chain model. For simulation, the documented contents can support inventory and spare-parts capacity planning in freight and infrastructure supply chains. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
